tasks.title: Canonicalize the truth-first roadmap stack and readiness package
tasks.description: Freeze the new planning backbone, align plan sources, and define one canonical readiness package for the current cycle.
acceptance_criteria: One canonical roadmap stack is named.
Readiness package scope is explicit.
Later UW artifacts reference the same backbone.

tasks.title: Refresh repo credibility and signoff truth artifacts
tasks.description: Refresh signoff evidence, reconcile stale signoff counters, and make the latest release-truth state explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Current signoff blockers are named.
Evidence refresh expectations are explicit.
Repo credibility blockers are tracked centrally.

tasks.title: Reconcile docs, workflow maps, and tracker truth
tasks.description: Align docs, tracker notes, and workflow map statements with the repo's actual current posture.
acceptance_criteria: Docs no longer contradict current auth or readiness truth.
Trackers point to the current plan backbone.
Legacy drift is explicitly called out.

tasks.title: Complete admin auth truth closure
tasks.description: Finish the admin JWT migration across backend, frontend, proxy, docs, and tests so shared-key auth is no longer the canonical path.
acceptance_criteria: Admin UI no longer relies on legacy shared-key login as the primary flow.
Proxy and handler contracts align on canonical auth.
Docs and tests match the canonical path.

tasks.title: Complete portal auth truth closure
tasks.description: Remove fail-closed placeholder auth UX by implementing or truthfully constraining passkey and portal login flows.
acceptance_criteria: Portal auth does not advertise unavailable completion flows.
Passkey posture is truthful in API and UI.
Auth-related docs and tests are aligned.

tasks.title: Define workflow engine production and fallback contract
tasks.description: Make the runtime behavior of Temporal and fallback mode explicit, bounded, and operator-explainable.
acceptance_criteria: Production semantics are explicit.
Fallback semantics are explicit.
Operators can explain runtime behavior during Temporal degradation.

tasks.title: Make treasury defaults evidence-backed
tasks.description: Replace sample-heavy treasury defaults with evidence-backed live-read pathways and provenance declarations.
acceptance_criteria: Treasury default read path is evidence-backed.
Sample paths are no longer the default production-facing route.
Source-of-truth is visible.

tasks.title: Make reconciliation defaults evidence-backed
tasks.description: Replace fixture-driven reconciliation defaults with lineage-backed runtime truth.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation default read path is evidence-backed.
Lineage and provenance are explicit.
Recommendation-only behavior is bounded and visible.

tasks.title: Harden webhook and event truth
tasks.description: Make webhook delivery state, replay provenance, dedupe guarantees, and event truth more authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: Webhook replay provenance is explicit.
Delivery-state truth is operator-explainable.
Event assumptions for multi-instance use are explicit.

tasks.title: Harden incident lineage and operator truth
tasks.description: Remove or replace dead-path incident lookups and tighten incident correlation to real evidence sources.
acceptance_criteria: High-impact incident lookups are evidence-backed.
Dead-path correlation is removed or explicitly bounded.
Operator incident truth is clearer.

tasks.title: Reach truthful CLI parity for READY surfaces
tasks.description: Make the packaged CLI match its declared READY ledger closely enough to trust as the first agent surface.
acceptance_criteria: READY ledger and implementation parity are close.
CLI docs no longer oversell coverage.
Operator-safe usage is trustworthy.

tasks.title: Add watch mode and approval-aware distribution truth
tasks.description: Add at least one real JSONL watch path and tighten approval boundaries for high-impact CLI actions.
acceptance_criteria: At least one real watch path emits stable JSONL.
High-impact mutations are approval-aware.
Placeholder command behavior is removed or explicitly bounded.

tasks.title: Draft thin MCP contract on truthful CLI surfaces
tasks.description: Select operator-safe read-heavy surfaces that can later be exposed through a thin MCP layer built on the truthful CLI contract.
acceptance_criteria: MCP candidate surfaces are curated.
The contract is read-heavy and approval-bounded.
CLI remains the primary truthful surface.

tasks.title: Persist config bundle governance authoritatively
tasks.description: Move config bundle governance from fallback-heavy behavior toward authoritative persisted records.
acceptance_criteria: Config bundle state is authoritative under normal paths.
Fallback behavior is explicit and bounded.
Admin views expose provenance.

tasks.title: Persist extension governance authoritatively
tasks.description: Make extension governance records authoritative and consistent with config bundle and rollout metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Extension governance records are authoritative.
Approval and rollout metadata are explicit.
Admin surfaces are provenance-aware.

tasks.title: Move provider routing to authoritative runtime use
tasks.description: Promote provider routing from snapshot/evaluator-only posture toward runtime truth on current seams.
acceptance_criteria: Provider routing state is not only evaluative.
Routing decisions expose matched context and provenance.
Pilot flows can depend on the records.

tasks.title: Move commercial readiness to authoritative runtime use
tasks.description: Replace placeholder or purely advisory commercial readiness behavior with governed records and explicit source states.
acceptance_criteria: Commercial readiness reads governed records by default.
Fallback source is explicit when used.
Admin surfaces expose missing prerequisites clearly.

tasks.title: Wire execution explainability to real routing inputs
tasks.description: Bind execution explainability to real liquidity, treasury, corridor, and compliance inputs instead of leaving it as a detached evaluator.
acceptance_criteria: Explainability reads real route inputs.
Eligibility and score reasons are operator-explainable.
The seam supports corridor-brain evolution without engine replacement.

tasks.title: Verify additive and backward-compatible boundaries
tasks.description: Audit the evolving implementation plan and planned schema changes for additive-only and backward-compatible boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Additive-only assumptions are explicit.
Backward-compatibility impacts are named.
No hidden rewrite drift exists in the plan.

tasks.title: Compose partner registry into pilot commercialization packs
tasks.description: Use partner registry records to build the first governed commercialization pack on current seams.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot partner pack exists.
Partner capability and approval state are explicit.
The pack can be referenced by pilot corridor logic.

tasks.title: Compose corridor packs and payment methods into pilot lanes
tasks.description: Bind corridor packs, payment-method capabilities, and provider-routing decisions into one or two pilot lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot corridor lanes are represented explicitly.
Payment method and compliance route are bound to the lane.
Lane behavior is explainable from current records.

tasks.title: Add venue trust substrate schema
tasks.description: Add additive schema for wallet attestation, venue linkage, venue transfers, beneficiary profiles, and source-of-funds packages.
acceptance_criteria: Core venue trust objects have additive schema.
Migration ordering is valid after the current repo sequence.
Cash-in and cash-out can share these trust objects.

tasks.title: Add venue repositories and services
tasks.description: Introduce repositories and service seams for wallet attestation, venue connection, venue account, and venue transfer lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Venue trust objects have repository and service seams.
Lifecycle transitions are explicit.
The substrate is connector-agnostic.

tasks.title: Add product eligibility and source-of-funds support
tasks.description: Create a bounded service for venue visibility and action permission, and package evidence for review-heavy venue flows.
acceptance_criteria: Venue visibility and funding permission are explicit decisions.
Source-of-funds packaging is reusable across venue flows.
Fast-lane versus review-lane behavior is explainable.

tasks.title: Add operator review surfaces for venue trust objects
tasks.description: Expose wallet attestation, venue linkage, venue transfer, and source-of-funds review to admin surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can review venue trust objects.
Review state and failure reason are visible.
Operator surfaces are provenance-aware.

tasks.title: Add portal venue funding APIs
tasks.description: Expose venue listing, eligibility, connection, funding prepare, funding submit, and status APIs without collapsing them into generic payin APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Portal can prepare venue funding explicitly.
Wallet-first funding is preserved.
Venue funding status is queryable as a first-class flow.

tasks.title: Add portal and admin venue UI
tasks.description: Add venue funding pages and workbenches while keeping generic deposit and venue funding as separate but connected flows.
acceptance_criteria: Venue funding has explicit portal UI.
Admin has venue funding workbench visibility.
Deposit-to-wallet and wallet-to-venue are not conflated in UX.

tasks.title: Ship Hyperliquid cash-out connector MVP
tasks.description: Implement read-only linking and wallet-centric venue cash-out using existing off-ramp and RFQ seams.
acceptance_criteria: Hyperliquid is integrated as connector #1.
Venue cash-out runs through wallet and off-ramp seams.
The connector validates the generic venue substrate.

tasks.title: Ship generic wallet-first venue cash-in flow
tasks.description: Complete the generic venue-aware cash-in path from fiat to approved wallet to tracked venue deposit.
acceptance_criteria: Venue cash-in uses wallet-first flow.
Cash-in is no longer only generic payin without venue transfer semantics.
The flow is auditable and reviewable.

tasks.title: Ship Hyperliquid funding connector on the generic substrate
tasks.description: Implement wallet-first Hyperliquid funding on top of venue trust and transfer objects rather than ad hoc payin metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Hyperliquid funding uses generic venue transfer semantics.
Wallet-first policy is preserved.
Venue-specific asset and network guardrails are explicit.

tasks.title: Ship Lighter operator/pro connector slice
tasks.description: Add a read-only and operator-focused connector slice for Lighter aligned with institutional evidence and public-pool style operations.
acceptance_criteria: Lighter is modeled as operator/pro first.
Connector uses generic venue substrate.
Institutional evidence and review paths are reused.

tasks.title: Prepare CEX connector family readiness model
tasks.description: Define the generic readiness model for CEX connectors including API scopes, subaccounts, withdrawal allowlists, and custody boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: CEX-specific optional fields are modeled as extensions.
Custody and allowlist assumptions are explicit.
The core remains venue-agnostic.

tasks.title: Unify venue cash-out and cash-in trust reporting
tasks.description: Use shared trust objects and evidence exports across both venue-linked directions so operators do not review two disconnected systems.
acceptance_criteria: Cash-out and cash-in reuse trust objects.
Reporting can show both directions coherently.
Operator review is less fragmented.

tasks.title: Expose operator-safe surfaces through MCP thin layer
tasks.description: Publish a thin read-heavy MCP layer on top of truthful CLI or direct safe surfaces only after auth and CLI truth are stable.
acceptance_criteria: Initial MCP layer is read-heavy and safe.
Approval-bounded mutate exposure remains limited.
The contract follows truthful CLI schemas.

tasks.title: Define delegation and execution-envelope prerequisites
tasks.description: Specify the prerequisites and model for delegation grants and execution envelopes only after auth, CLI, MCP, and venue trust substrate are stable.
acceptance_criteria: Delegation prerequisites are explicit.
The model depends on truthful auth and tool contracts.
It does not bypass approval-aware boundaries.
